title: salacia reticulata var. diandra
intro: Salacia reticulata var. diandra, commonly known as Bawaseera or Saptarangi, is a plant species that belongs to the family Celastraceae. It is widely used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-diabetic and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its potential to aid in weight management and improve lipid profiles. The therapeutic actions of Salacia reticulata var. diandra are attributed to its ability to inhibit carbohydrate absorption, reduce glucose levels, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-hyperlipidemic activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salacin, corosolic acid, and 3-hydroxy-3-phenyl-2-oxo-1-indanecarboxylic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
